release_notes.en-US: Reduces false warnings on legitimate Microsoft Teams government-cloud meeting and dial-in links, aka.ms help links, and Microsoft Safe Links-wrapped email URLs. Safe Links are unwrapped locally only on Microsoft's documented hostname, and their embedded destinations remain fully checked for suspicious patterns.

version.approval_notes: Version 0.1.4 is a focused false-positive correction based on legitimate Microsoft Teams government-cloud meeting and dial-in links. Microsoft documentation identifies *.teams.microsoft.us as government-cloud endpoints and *.safelinks.protection.outlook.com as the standard Safe Links rewrite hostname. The extension now recognizes microsoft.us and .microsoft as official Microsoft namespaces, treats aka.ms and established Microsoft service domains as related identities for visible-domain comparison, and unwraps only the documented Safe Links hostname. The embedded destination is still analyzed for shorteners, IP addresses, visible-domain mismatch, and brand impersonation; lookalike Safe Links hosts and suffix attacks remain flagged. No permissions, data practices, network behavior, telemetry, or remote services changed. Analysis remains entirely on-device with declared data collection none. Validation covered 83 new Teams/Microsoft/Safe Links adversarial permutations, a 56-case dynamic browser fixture, and the supplied 150-case torture fixture in headless Firefox ESR 140. Mozilla lint reported no errors, warnings, or notices.
